notes: Planned data-centre campus of up to 1,000 MW in Skellefteå. No public commissioning schedule has been announced; development depends on permitting.
coordinate_note: Approximate point for Skellefteå municipality seat.

notes: AI-centre investment framework of up to SEK 95 billion in Strängnäs. The project expands an earlier/base 300 MW plan to 750 MW, but electricity supply and final scope remain unresolved in later reporting; no precise commissioning schedule has been publicly identified.
coordinate_note: Approximate point for Strängnäs municipality seat.

notes: EcoDataCenter campus at Kvarnsveden. First halls are planned for 2027 with at least 250 MW capacity; the campus can scale to around 600 MW over time.
coordinate_note: Approximate point for Borlänge municipality seat.

notes: Planned 300 MW campus at Hamre Industrial Park in Sollefteå. The site is prepared for high-density racks and expected to enter operation in H1 2028.

Marviken HPC/AI facility marketed with 20 MW initial capacity, 95 MW target scale by end-2026, and a possible longer-term 300 MW expansion. Treat execution as uncertain because EdgeMode's 2026 SEC filing discloses litigation over the SAPL transaction and impairment/possession issues for related assets.

Original 2023 EcoDataCenter sources announced a 150 MW circular campus in Östersund with 20 MW planned for 2026, but current EcoDataCenter site material uses EcoDataCenter 2 for Borlänge/Kvarnsveden. Treat Östersund timing and current status as unresolved until refreshed primary evidence is found.
coordinate_note: Approximate point for Östersund municipality seat.

notes: Concept-stage SMR-linked data centre at Studsvik. Memorandum of understanding concerns supply from small modular reactors of around 55 MW per reactor; no data-centre load estimate is identified.
Planned atNorth SWE02 metro data centre in Kista, close to SWE01. Expected to enter operation in Q4 2027 with 30 MW capacity, heat-recovery integration and a new customer substation.
Conapto Stockholm 5 North. First phase around 14 MW IT capacity with 28 MW power supply by June 2027; full plan exceeds 28 MW IT capacity, corresponding to approximately 40 MW power supply, by 2029.
coordinate_note: Approximate point for northern Stockholm/Kista area.

notes: Mistral AI and EcoDataCenter partnership for an AI-focused data centre at the Borlänge campus. Expected to open in 2027 with approximately 23 MW compute capacity.
coordinate_note: Approximate point for Borlänge municipality seat.

notes: Evroc flagship AI data centre in Arlandastad with 18 MW capacity. The February 2025 release described up to 16,000 GPUs, while evroc's current data-center page describes up to 10,000 GPUs and says the site is being built; operation is still targeted for H2 2026.
ScandiDC data centre developed in a rock cavern in Eskilstuna. Phase 1 of up to 6 MW is expected to be completed in Q4 2026; the site is prepared for up to 10 MW IT load.
coordinate_note: Approximate point for Eskilstuna municipality seat.

notes: Expansion of GlobalConnect’s existing data centre in southern Stockholm. Adds 1.2 MW and increases the facility to 2.7 MW, with launch expected in 2026.

Google Horndal/Avesta permitted project. Environmental permit and building permit exist, and preparatory groundworks have been reported, but Google still says no formal business decision to build has been taken. The 2021 permit concerns up to 1,500 MW installed backup-power capacity; no public IT/grid-load estimate has been identified.
